# Eagle-5 Yield Excursion Review

## Discussion

**Sarah Chen:** Eagle-5 yield dropped from 91% to 82% over the last two weeks. I want to understand the root cause before the customer notices.

**Marcus Rivera:** The drop is concentrated in wafer lot 4412 and 4415. Defect maps show edge ring failures, which points at the etch chamber 3 seal we replaced on February 20.

**Tom Bradley:** Chamber 3 was requalified, but the particle counts were borderline. We can take it offline for 48 hours.

**Jennifer Liu:** If any of these lots shipped to automotive customers we need to open a containment action.

## Decisions

- Take etch chamber 3 offline for 48 hours for a full seal inspection.
- Hold lots 4412 and 4415 pending failure analysis.

## Action Items

- Marcus Rivera to complete failure analysis on lot 4412 by March 7.
- Tom Bradley to schedule the chamber 3 inspection this week.
- Jennifer Liu to check shipment records for affected lots by March 6.
